name: TestNG Test Framework for Java
certifications: No official TestNG certification; assessed by capstone projects
ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE)
Oracle Certified Professional Java SE Developer (optional)

beginner.summary: For testers and Java developers learning TestNG as the runner for automated tests. Covers TestNG with Maven, Java essentials for tests, annotations and the test lifecycle, hard and soft assertions, testng.xml suites, groups, dependencies and priorities, parameters, DataProvider, timeouts and expected exceptions, enabling and skipping tests, default reports, running from the IDE and Maven, Selenium and REST Assured with TestNG, logging, debugging and a first framework.
prerequisites: Basic Java or another programming language
Understands test cases and test design
Can install a JDK and an IDE
outcomes: Write and organise TestNG tests with annotations, groups and suites
Drive tests with parameters and data providers
Run suites from the IDE and Maven and read TestNG reports
Use TestNG as the runner for Selenium and REST Assured tests

days.topic: TestNG Overview, Installation and Project Setup
subtopics: What TestNG is and where it fits
Installing a JDK and IntelliJ IDEA or Eclipse
Writing and running a first test
days.lab_task: Create a Maven project with TestNG, write a first test class with two tests, run it from the IDE and from Maven and open the default report.
days.deliverable: Maven project with a first passing test class
checks: Tests run from the IDE plugin
The default report opens and shows results
objectives: Run tests from the IDE and Maven

days.topic: Java Essentials for TestNG Users
days.lab_task: Write a base test class and two test classes that extend it, use collections for test data and fix three compile and runtime errors.
days.deliverable: Base and test classes with fixed examples
checks: Test classes reuse the base class
Test data is held in lists and maps

days.topic: Annotations and the Test Lifecycle
subtopics: alwaysRun and when to use it
days.lab_task: Add print statements to every lifecycle annotation across two classes and a suite, predict the order, run it and explain any differences.
checks: The predicted order is written before running
The actual order is captured from output
Differences from the prediction are explained

days.topic: Assertions: Hard and Soft
subtopics: Assertion libraries such as AssertJ with TestNG
days.lab_task: Write tests with hard and soft assertions for a page of results, show the difference when several checks fail and rewrite two assertions that could never fail.
checks: Hard and soft assertions are both used
The report shows the difference in failure output
Two always-passing assertions now fail when they should

days.topic: testng.xml: Suites, Tests and Classes
subtopics: Running a suite file from the IDE and Maven
days.lab_task: Create smoke and regression suite files that include and exclude methods and packages, and run each from the IDE and from Maven.
days.deliverable: Two suite files with run results
checks: Smoke and regression suites include the right tests

days.topic: Groups for Organising and Selecting Tests
subtopics: Including and excluding groups in suites
days.lab_task: Tag tests with smoke, regression and module groups, define a metagroup, and run combinations of groups from suite files and Maven.
checks: Every test has a type group and a module group
A metagroup runs its member groups
Group runs from Maven select the right tests

days.topic: Dependencies and Priorities
subtopics: priority and its effect on order
Why independent tests are usually better
days.lab_task: Build a login, create and delete flow with method dependencies, see how a failed step skips the rest, then rewrite one flow as independent tests and compare.
days.deliverable: Dependent and independent versions with comparison
checks: Later steps skip when an earlier one fails
Priorities change the run order as expected
Independent tests are compared with the dependent flow

days.topic: Parameters from testng.xml and the Command Line
days.lab_task: Pass browser and environment parameters from testng.xml and override them from the Maven command line, with optional defaults for local runs.
checks: Tests read parameters from the suite file
Maven command-line values override the suite
Optional defaults apply when nothing is passed

days.topic: DataProvider for Data-Driven Tests
subtopics: Reading CSV, JSON and Excel data
days.lab_task: Drive a login test from a data provider reading Excel, a pricing test from JSON and a search test from CSV, with clear names for each run.
checks: Each data row runs as a separate test
Data loads from Excel, JSON and CSV
Failing rows are identifiable in the report

days.topic: Timeouts, Expected Exceptions and Invocation Counts
days.lab_task: Add timeouts to slow tests, test expected exceptions with message checks and run one test many times with invocationCount to measure its stability.
days.deliverable: Tests using timeouts, exceptions and invocation counts
checks: Slow tests fail at the timeout
Exception tests check type and message
The repeated test reports a stability rate

days.topic: Enabling, Skipping and Ignoring Tests
days.lab_task: Skip tests by environment at run time, ignore a known-bug test with a ticket reference and produce a report that lists all skipped tests with reasons.
days.deliverable: Skip rules and a skipped-tests report
checks: Environment-specific tests skip with a reason
Skipped tests and reasons are listed

days.topic: TestNG Reports and Logging
days.lab_task: Add logging to tests, write Reporter.log messages, produce the emailable report and an Allure report with attachments, and compare them for a manager and a developer.
checks: Logs show test steps at the right levels
Emailable and Allure reports are produced
Reports are matched to their readers

days.topic: Maven and Surefire for TestNG
subtopics: Failing the build on test failures
days.lab_task: Configure Surefire to run suites by profile, pass groups and parameters, rerun failures once and make the build fail when tests fail.
checks: Groups and parameters come from Maven

days.topic: Selenium WebDriver with TestNG
days.lab_task: Build a Selenium base test with TestNG lifecycle methods, write data-driven login tests and capture screenshots on failure.
checks: Browsers start and stop through lifecycle methods
Login runs from a data provider

days.topic: REST Assured with TestNG
subtopics: Running API and UI suites together
days.lab_task: Write API tests with REST Assured on TestNG with a base specification class, data providers and soft assertions, and run them with the UI suite.
checks: API inputs come from data providers
API and UI suites run in one Maven build

days.topic: Page Objects and Base Classes in TestNG Projects
subtopics: Base page and base test classes
days.lab_task: Refactor UI tests into page objects with a base page and base test, move waits and screenshots into utilities and show a locator change needs one edit.
checks: Waits and screenshots live in utilities
A locator change is fixed in one place

days.topic: Configuration and Environments for TestNG Suites
days.lab_task: Move URLs and credentials into environment properties and environment variables, switch environments by profile and fail fast on missing settings.
checks: No URLs or credentials are hard-coded
Missing settings stop the run clearly

days.topic: Debugging TestNG Tests
subtopics: Skipped tests and why they skip
days.lab_task: Diagnose four broken suites (a failing @BeforeClass, a data provider error, a missing dependency and a wrong suite path), fix them and write a debugging checklist.
checks: Each failure has a recorded cause
The checklist covers the steps used

days.topic: Running TestNG Suites in CI
subtopics: Jenkins or GitHub Actions for Maven projects
Running suites by profile and group
days.lab_task: Run smoke suites on pull requests and regression nightly in CI with headless browsers, publish reports and fix one CI-only failure.

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: TestNG Framework for UI and API Tests
days.lab_task: Build a TestNG framework for a web shop with UI and API tests, suites and groups, data providers, configuration for two environments and reports, running in CI.
checks: Suites and groups select tests correctly
UI and API journeys have passing tests
The pipeline runs and publishes reports
objectives: Build a UI and API framework

intermediate.summary: For testers and SDETs who use TestNG daily and now build team frameworks. Covers listeners, retry analysers, parallel execution and thread safety, factories, annotation transformers, method interceptors, custom reporters, Allure and Extent reporting in depth, data sources, Selenium Grid runs, BDD with Cucumber on TestNG, test data management, flaky tests, suite design for large projects, Maven and Gradle in depth, Docker, JUnit 5 comparison and code quality.
prerequisites: Writes TestNG tests with groups, suites and data providers
Has run TestNG suites in CI
outcomes: Extend TestNG with listeners, transformers and interceptors
Run large suites in parallel safely with clear reports
Design suites and data for many tests and environments
Keep frameworks stable, fast and maintainable

days.topic: Listeners: ITestListener, ISuiteListener and Others
subtopics: Registering listeners in code, XML and services
days.lab_task: Write a listener that logs test start and end, attaches screenshots on failure and writes a summary at suite end, and register it three different ways.
checks: Logs and screenshots are produced at the right events
The listener works when registered in code, XML and services
The suite summary is written at the end

days.topic: Retry Analysers and Handling Intermittent Failures
subtopics: Applying retries globally with a transformer
days.lab_task: Add a retry analyser applied to all tests through a transformer, limit it to one retry, report retried tests separately and write a retry policy.
checks: Retried tests appear separately in the report
The policy limits retries and requires diagnosis

days.topic: Parallel Execution: Methods, Classes, Tests and Instances
subtopics: thread-count and data provider thread count
days.lab_task: Run the suite in parallel by methods and by classes, make drivers thread-safe with ThreadLocal, fix two shared-state bugs and compare durations.
checks: Durations are compared with serial runs

days.topic: Factories and Dynamic Test Creation
subtopics: Creating test instances per browser or environment
days.lab_task: Use a factory to create test class instances for three browsers, combine it with a data provider and run the instances in parallel.
checks: The factory uses a data provider

days.topic: Annotation Transformers and Method Interceptors
subtopics: Changing timeouts, retries and enabled flags at run time
days.lab_task: Write a transformer that sets timeouts by group and an interceptor that runs smoke tests first and filters tests by a custom annotation.
checks: Timeouts change by group at run time
Tests are filtered by the custom annotation

days.topic: Custom Reporters with IReporter
subtopics: Writing HTML, CSV or JSON reports
Sending summaries to chat or email
days.lab_task: Write a reporter that produces a JSON summary with environment and build data and posts pass, fail and skip counts to a chat webhook.
checks: The JSON summary includes results and build data

days.topic: Allure and Extent Reports in Depth
subtopics: Choosing one tool for the team
days.lab_task: Configure Allure and Extent for the suite with steps, attachments and ticket links, publish both from CI and recommend one for the team.
days.deliverable: Two configured reports and a recommendation
checks: Both reports show steps and screenshots

days.topic: Data Sources: Excel, JSON, Databases and APIs
days.lab_task: Build a data utility that loads data from Excel, JSON and a database by environment, validates it before tests and feeds three data providers.
checks: Data comes from all three sources
Bad data is rejected before tests run
Three data providers use the utility

days.topic: Selenium Grid and Cross-Browser Runs with TestNG
days.lab_task: Run the UI suite on a Docker Selenium Grid with three browsers in parallel from one suite file and collect videos for failures.
objectives: Run TestNG suites on a grid

days.topic: Cucumber BDD on the TestNG Runner
subtopics: When to use BDD with TestNG
days.lab_task: Run Cucumber features through a TestNG runner in parallel, map tags to groups and produce Cucumber and Allure reports.
days.deliverable: Cucumber features on TestNG with reports
checks: Features run through the TestNG runner

days.topic: Test Data Management for TestNG Suites
days.lab_task: Replace static data with builders and API-created data, isolate data for parallel threads and clean up in @AfterMethod even after failures.

days.topic: Flaky Tests: Diagnosis and Fixes
subtopics: Common causes in UI and API suites
Diagnosing with logs, screenshots and videos
days.lab_task: Repeat suspected flaky tests with invocationCount, diagnose three, fix them and move one unfixable test to a quarantine group with an owner.
checks: Flaky tests are listed with failure rates
Three tests pass fifty runs after fixes
The quarantined test has an owner and date

days.topic: Suite Design for Large Projects
subtopics: Suites by layer, module and priority
Smoke, sanity, regression and nightly suites
days.lab_task: Redesign the suite files for a large project into smoke, regression and nightly suites by module, remove duplicates and set run time targets.
checks: No test is run twice in one pipeline
Suites meet their run time targets

days.topic: Gradle with TestNG
subtopics: Gradle compared with Maven for test projects
Migrating a Maven test project to Gradle
days.lab_task: Run the TestNG suite with Gradle using groups, suite files and parallel forks, and compare build time and configuration with Maven.
checks: Maven and Gradle are compared for the team

days.topic: Running TestNG Suites in Docker
subtopics: Docker images for Java test projects
Docker Compose with the app and grid
days.lab_task: Run the suite in a container with the app and a Selenium Grid from Docker Compose, collect reports and fix one failure that appears only in containers.
checks: App, grid and tests start together
Reports are copied out of the container
The container-only failure has a cause and fix

days.topic: TestNG and JUnit 5 Compared
days.lab_task: Port ten TestNG tests to JUnit 5, map listeners to extensions and write a recommendation for a new project.

days.topic: Mocking and Unit-Level Tests with TestNG
subtopics: Fast tests compared with integration tests
Keeping unit and integration suites separate
days.lab_task: Write unit tests with Mockito for the framework's utilities, measure coverage with JaCoCo and run unit tests before integration suites.
checks: Unit tests run before integration suites

days.topic: Code Quality for TestNG Frameworks
subtopics: Static analysis with SonarQube or SpotBugs
days.lab_task: Run static analysis on the framework, fix the main issues, write a review checklist and remove two low-value tests.
checks: The checklist is used on a pull request
Two low-value tests are removed with reasons

days.topic: Integrating TestNG with Test Management Tools
subtopics: Publishing results to Xray, Zephyr or TestRail
days.lab_task: Add case ID annotations, upload results to a test management tool with a listener and produce a requirement coverage report.
checks: Results appear in the tool after a run

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Extensible TestNG Framework with Parallel Runs
days.lab_task: Build a team-ready TestNG framework with listeners, controlled retries, a transformer and interceptor, thread-safe parallel grid runs, data utilities, Allure and test management integration, and hand it to a colleague to extend.
checks: Listeners, transformer and interceptor work together
A colleague adds a test without help

advanced.summary: For automation leads and SDETs who own Java test automation across teams. Covers framework architecture for many teams, TestNG internals and extension points, configuration as code, orchestration of very large suites, test impact analysis, distributed execution, observability, contract and integration testing alongside TestNG, test data platforms, containers and ephemeral environments, AI-assisted test generation, governance, migration strategies, performance of the framework itself, security of test code, contributing to TestNG, team enablement, strategy and troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Has built and maintained a TestNG framework used by a team
Understands test strategy and large codebases
outcomes: Architect TestNG-based automation for many teams
Orchestrate and observe very large suites efficiently
Extend TestNG safely and keep frameworks secure and fast
Lead Java automation governance, migrations and capability

days.topic: Modular TestNG Architecture for Many Teams
subtopics: Shared core libraries and team modules
Maven multi-module or Gradle composite builds
days.lab_task: Split a large framework into a shared core and team modules, release the core with a version and onboard a new team with a template.
days.deliverable: Modular architecture, released core and onboarding record
checks: Team modules depend only on the released core
The core is published with a version
A new team runs tests from the template

days.topic: TestNG Internals and Extension Points
subtopics: How TestNG builds and runs a suite
days.lab_task: Trace a suite run through TestNG's internals in the debugger, implement an IHookable that wraps tests with timing and an IAlterSuiteListener that changes suites at start.
days.deliverable: Internal trace notes and two extensions
checks: The run path is explained from the debugger
IHookable records timing for every test
Suites change at start as designed

days.topic: Configuration as Code for Suites
subtopics: Dynamic selection by risk or change
days.lab_task: Generate suites from a YAML file of modules and tiers with the XmlSuite API, validate them before running and run a generated smoke suite.

days.topic: Orchestrating Very Large Suites
days.lab_task: Split a large suite across six machines balanced by historical duration, merge results into one report and add a fail-fast smoke stage.
checks: Machines finish within a small time range
Smoke failures stop the pipeline early

days.topic: Test Impact Analysis for Java Suites
subtopics: Mapping tests to code with coverage
Selecting by module and dependency graph
Nightly full runs as a safety net
days.lab_task: Build change-based selection from coverage data and the module graph, run only affected tests on pull requests and report feedback time and missed defects over two weeks.
checks: Tests map to classes and modules
Pull requests run affected tests plus smoke
Feedback time and missed defects are reported

days.topic: Distributed Execution on Grids and Clouds
days.lab_task: Run the suite on a Kubernetes-hosted grid and a cloud grid, compare speed, reliability and cost and plan capacity for peak runs.
checks: The suite runs on both infrastructures
Speed, reliability and cost are compared

days.topic: Exporting TestNG Results for Dashboards and Alerts
subtopics: Dashboards for pass rate, duration and flakiness
days.lab_task: Export results with a listener to a database, add correlation IDs to requests, build a dashboard and alert on rising failure rates.
checks: A rising failure rate triggers the alert

days.topic: Contract and Integration Testing Alongside TestNG
subtopics: Where end-to-end tests are too expensive
Pact JVM with TestNG or JUnit
days.lab_task: Replace ten end-to-end checks with contract and integration tests using Pact, WireMock and Testcontainers, and show the coverage map before and after.
checks: Contract tests run for two services
Integration tests run against stubs and containers
The coverage map shows each behaviour at one main layer

days.topic: Test Data Platforms for Large Organisations
subtopics: Data services and APIs for tests
days.lab_task: Design a test data service with synthetic data, reservation for parallel runs and masking rules, connect the framework to it and measure data failures before and after.
days.deliverable: Data service design, integration and comparison
checks: The service covers generation, reservation and masking
The framework requests data from the service

days.topic: Containers and Ephemeral Environments for Test Runs
subtopics: When shared environments are still needed
days.lab_task: Run the suite against a preview environment created per pull request with readiness checks and seeded data, then remove the environment.
checks: Each pull request gets an environment
Tests start only after readiness passes

days.topic: AI-Assisted Test Generation for Java Suites
subtopics: Generating tests from requirements and code
Mutation testing with PIT to check test strength
days.lab_task: Generate tests for a service class with an AI assistant, measure their strength with PIT, improve weak ones and record effort and results.
days.deliverable: Reviewed tests, mutation results and effort record
checks: Mutation scores are recorded before and after review

days.topic: Governance for Java Test Automation
subtopics: Standards for structure, naming and data
days.lab_task: Write standards and a dependency policy, build a coverage map, review twenty tests, remove obsolete ones and report status to leads.
days.deliverable: Standards, coverage map, review records and report
checks: Standards cover structure, data and ownership

days.topic: Migration Strategies: TestNG, JUnit 5 and Beyond
subtopics: Migrating suites and groups to tags
days.lab_task: Plan the migration of a module from TestNG to JUnit 5 or the reverse, migrate a slice with listeners and groups, run both side by side and report the results.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, migrated slice and report

days.topic: Performance of the Framework Itself
days.lab_task: Profile a slow suite, find framework overhead in setup, listeners and logging, fix the top three causes and measure the improvement.
checks: Framework overhead is measured by area
The top three causes are fixed

days.topic: Security of Test Code and Test Infrastructure
subtopics: Secrets in test code and logs
A security checklist for test teams
days.lab_task: Scan the test repository and dependencies, move secrets into CI or a vault, reduce test account permissions and write a security checklist.
checks: Secrets and vulnerable dependencies are found
No secrets remain in code or logs

days.topic: Enabling Teams in Java Test Automation
days.lab_task: Assess a team's Java automation skills, design a learning path, provide a starter project and coach a manual tester to a first merged test.
days.deliverable: Skills assessment, learning path and first merged test
checks: Each person has a skills rating
The starter project builds on a new machine
A manual tester merges a first test

days.topic: Strategy for Java Test Automation
days.lab_task: Write a Java automation strategy with risks, layers, frameworks, ownership and a one-year roadmap, and present it to engineering leaders.
days.deliverable: Strategy and roadmap with presentation notes

days.topic: Release Quality Gates from TestNG Results
subtopics: Gates for pull requests and releases
Pass rate, flakiness and coverage thresholds
days.lab_task: Define quality gates from TestNG results, implement them in the pipeline and produce a release readiness report for a sample release.
days.deliverable: Gate definitions, pipeline changes and readiness report
checks: Each gate has a threshold and reason
A failing gate blocks the pipeline
The readiness report shows gates and risks

days.topic: Troubleshooting Large TestNG Frameworks
days.lab_task: Diagnose four failures in a large framework (a listener conflict, a parallel state leak, a dependency clash and an environment issue), reproduce two locally and write a troubleshooting guide.
checks: Each failure has a confirmed cause
The guide covers the steps used

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Java Test Automation Platform for Several Teams
days.lab_task: Design and build a Java automation platform for three teams with a shared core, orchestrated and impact-selected runs, observability, contract and integration layers, governance and security, and present it to engineering leadership.
checks: All teams build on the shared core
Pull request feedback meets the target
objectives: Build a platform for many teams
